name: instant-worker — flow_synthetic leak [cleanup-ledger breach, resource leaking]
description: P2 when the synthetic runner's rule-24 cleanup ledger breaches: instant_flow_synthetic_reaped_total{outcome="leaked"} > 0. The runner provisions a real resource per provision_reap tick and MUST delete it via the real delete path; a leaked outcome means the delete failed and a real DO/k8s resource is leaking (a cost + a breach of the 'never leak resources' promise). Must stay 0. Triage: the slog ERROR line flow_synthetic_leaked carries resource_id + run_id; the synthetic.reaped audit_log row records every reap attempt. Manually deprovision the leaked resource. The reaper backstop sweeps orphans older than 30m, so a SUSTAINED non-zero means even the backstop is failing. INERT until FLOW_SYNTHETIC_ENABLED=true. Source: worker/internal/jobs/flow_synthetic.go (reapResource / reapOrphans), metric registered in worker/internal/metrics/metrics.go (FlowSyntheticReapedTotal).

nrql.query: SELECT sum(instant_flow_synthetic_reaped_total) FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'instant_flow_synthetic_reaped_total' AND outcome = 'leaked'
